personality: 4 Tactile / Playful modified for high-speed utility (Chunky targets, bold colors)
personality_one_liner: A fast, tactile, and highly legible point-of-sale system that feels durable, friendly, and error-proof in a fast-paced grocery environment.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Touch targets minimum 56pt height for core actions (POS environment requires fat-finger prevention). Pad product cards with md, screen edges with lg.

do's: Use heavy-tint frosted glass for the persistent bottom cart summary in Kasir screen so content flows behind it cleanly.
Use blur on bottom tab bar to maintain screen depth.
dont's: No blur on product cards or fast-moving lists as it affects scroll performance.
No blur on low-end android devices (fallback to solid surfaceSecondary).

screens.name: Login (PIN)
screens.purpose: Secure, fast entry into the POS app using a large numeric keypad.

states.error: Shake animation on keypad + red warning text

screens.layout: Hero abstract gradient image taking top 30% of screen with WarungPintar logo overlaid (gradient scrim applied). Below it, a giant numeric keypad (each key minimum 64pt height/width). Visual PIN dots feedback above the keypad.

screens.name: Kasir (POS/Home)
screens.purpose: Primary operational screen to quickly search, select quantities, and calculate totals.

states.empty: Illustration of empty box with 'Belum ada barang di toko' and button 'Tambah Barang'

screens.layout: Top section: Sticky search bar (full width) and horizontal scrolling category chips (pill radius). Middle: 2-column grid of chunky product cards showing Name, Price, and Stock. If stock < 5, show a bold RED badge/outline. Bottom: Sticky fixed container showing 'Total Belanja' with a massive 'Bayar' CTA. Use KeyboardAvoidingView so search doesn't break layout.

screens.name: Stok (Inventory)
screens.purpose: CRUD list to manage grocery stock, update prices, and monitor low inventory.
screens.layout: List view for rapid scanning. Each row shows item name, category, modal price (HPP), selling price, and stock left. Rows with stock < 5 get a light red surfaceTertiary tint to alert the user instantly. Floating Action Button (FAB) at bottom right for 'Tambah Barang'.

screens.name: Laporan (Reports)
screens.purpose: Daily/weekly financial overview showing gross revenue, COGS, and net profit.

states.empty: Illustration of a chart with 'Belum ada penjualan hari ini'

screens.layout: Three large prominent metric cards at the top (Pendapatan Kotor, Total Modal, Keuntungan Bersih) with bold typography. Below it, a list of recent transactions. A sticky 'Ekspor CSV' action button.

screens.name: Pengaturan (Settings)
screens.purpose: Manage app themes (Light/Dark/Neutral), PIN reset, and export data.
screens.layout: Standard vertical list with grouped sections. Include a Segmented Control for Theme selection (Terang, Gelap, Netral). Tinted icon containers for each setting row.

login_hero_bg.alt: Abstract orange and yellow gradient background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT introduce any Blues or Purples. Stick to the Orange/Yellow 'brand' scales and the defined neutral/charcoal palettes.
Ensure touch targets are massive. The prompt specifies this is a cashier app, so 56pt minimum height for the 'Bayar' (Pay) button and numeric PIN pad. Fat-finger prevention is critical.
Typography: Use 'Space Grotesk' for big numbers, totals, and metrics (prices, quantity). Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for labels, body copy, and UI text.
Implement a prominent sticky 'Total Belanja' bottom container on the Kasir screen, allowing the product grid to scroll behind it. Ensure bottom safe area is respected.
For the low stock indicator (stock < 5), use the 'error' token to render a bold badge or border. In the Stok screen, tint the entire row if stock is critical.
Render the login hero image with a linear-gradient scrim (top-to-bottom, transparent to surface) to ensure any logo or text placed above the keypad remains fully legible.
Ensure total offline capability per user request; use local storage (e.g., SQLite or AsyncStorage) as the single source of truth.
